results.name: shop/worker

error.Text: Deployment shop/worker has 1 replicas but 0 are available with status running

results.details:
Error: The deployment "worker" in namespace "shop" expects 1 pod to run, but none are currently running.

Solution:
1. Check pod status: kubectl get pods -n shop
2. View pod logs: kubectl logs -n shop [pod-name]
3. Describe pod: kubectl describe pod -n shop [pod-name]
4. Fix issues found (image pull, resources, etc.)

results.details:
Error: Your container ran out of memory (OOM - Out Of Memory) and was killed by Kubernetes.

Solution:
1. Increase memory limits in your deployment YAML
2. Add: resources.limits.memory (e.g., "512Mi" or "1Gi")
3. Apply: kubectl apply -f deployment.yaml
4. Monitor: kubectl top pod
